# Asendify Notes

> Asendify Notes (https://notes.asendify.co) is a private, Notion-style workspace for notes, docs and projects, made by Asendify. It runs in any modern web browser.

## Key facts
- Pages inside pages (unlimited nesting), a block editor with slash commands (headings, bullet/numbered lists, to-dos, toggles, tables, quotes, code, images), drag to reorder blocks.
- Databases with text, number, select, checkbox, date and link properties, viewable as a table or a board (drag cards between columns). Each row is also a full page.
- Full-text search (Ctrl/Cmd K), trash with 30-day restore, read-only share links (can be turned off at any time), export a page to Markdown or the whole workspace to JSON at any time.
- Sign-in with one-time email links (no passwords). Light and dark mode. Saves automatically; editing in two tabs never silently overwrites.
- Price: £1,450 a year = £1,000 + 45% service fee (£450), shown in full before paying. No free plan, no free trial. Card buyers can choose auto-renew (£1,450 on the same date each year, with emails 14 and 3 days before; turn it off any time in Settings); PayPal is one year at a time. After a year ends without renewal, editing stops but notes are kept and can be exported for 30 days.
- One workspace per person; 2 GB of image storage.
- Installable Windows, macOS and Android apps are on the roadmap and not available yet.
- Not affiliated with Notion.
- Policies (payments and refunds): https://www.asendify.co/policies/
